main.description: Ball is a male meowstic. He likes trains and Weezer. He is part of the class of 2027 at Verr University.

Lit is a victini. She likes spaghetti and post grunge music. She is the main character in It's Been Awhile, a comic about the death of her sister Flingy due to Lit's criminal activity, and all that entails. She is part of the class of 2027 at Verr University.
Pinewood is a vulpix. She likes graphic T-shirts and The Offspring. She works at her uncle's furniture store.

info.name: Oakwood Silva
info.residence: 114 Poryglass St, Norbax, Friendship City, CT

main.description: Oakwood is a vulpix. He likes burgers and playing acoustic guitar. He works at his family's furniture store.

info.name: Martha Gunby
info.residence: 1106 Phoenix Av, Phoenix, Friendship City, CT

main.description: Martha is a meowstic. Her favorite foods are pineapple and ice cream. She works at Astorabat Park, picking up trash and managing the wildlife.

info.name: Liam Kennivari
info.residence: 1106 Phoenix Av, Phoenix, Friendship City, CT

main.description: Liam is a rabbit-dog. He likes iced coffee and pop music. He works at Rocky's Records and Guitars.

info.name: Comet Polaris Rahway
info.residence: Blair St, Doubax, Friendship City, CT

main.description: Comet is a male meowstic. He likes chocolate chip cookies and BeamNG drive. He is a lab assistant for the mad scientist Mose. He is part of the class of 2026 at Friendship University.
Arrow is a buizel. He is bisexual and likes Green Day. He is insecure about his poor swimming abilities. He is an author of travel books. He is part of the class of 2026 at Friendship University.
Sugar is an Eevee. He likes turkey bologna, computers, and taking pictures. He is part of the class of 2026 at Friendship University.
Ash is a white cat. He likes lemonade and legos. He is a research subject, drag queen, and performer.

info.name: Teri Sunnyside
info.occupation: Animal Daycare Worker and FOSS Developer

main.description: Teri is a cat dragon. He likes computers. They are very laid back, friendly, and silly. They are York's roommate! He works at an animal daycare.
Cypress is a green cat with wings. They are a very serious person. They eat pizza with a fork. They are a private investigator, running the Foreman Investigation Service.

info.name: Summer Hazel Culver
info.occupation: Business Owner and Guitarist for C.A.F.

main.description: Rocky is a pink dog. She is very friendly and energetic. He is a metalhead and a skilled guitarist. Her boyfriend is Nolan, and she sometimes calls him Oreo. She runs a music store in Arthur City, and employs Zilly and Liam.

Nolan is a gray foxwolf. He is extremely paranoid and jumpy. He is Rocky's boyfriend. He is transgender. He is also short, so he often takes pictures with Rocky while standing on a stool so he looks taller. He is a secret government agent.
Noel is a sprigatito. This means he likes weed. He is Pluto's best friend, and Ryder's boyfriend. He is Ryder's housewife.
Ryder is a calico cat. He likes to jog and play softball. He is Noel's boyfriend. He is a news reporter at at N3 News in Evergreen.
Tem is a fox. She likes onion rings and mystery novels. She works on buses at Friendship City Transit's Embridge bus facility.
Nisha is a Shaymin. They care deeply about what other people think of them. They go to Friendship University.
Esther is a tortoiseshell cat. She likes bananas and listening to Nightwish. She owns the Nightwish shoes and the Nightwish watch. She is an electrician.

info.name: Azure "Pocky Pulverize" Pullman
info.occupation: Walm Employee and Bassist for O.C.

main.description: Pocky is a blue cat. He likes root beer and listening to Megadeth. They work at a retail store in Evergreen.
Ram is a sheep. They like ugly sweaters and dirinks hot choocolate. They are a PhD student studying mathematics at some institution in Evergreen.
York is a glaceon. She likes to hang out in pools.
Sage is a cat. He likes hoagies. He is Miki's brother. He is part of the class of 2026 at Rutgers University.
Miki is a cat. They like fishing, anchovies and dislikes their anchovies being stolen by Sage and Wayne. It is a serious person. They are part of the class of 2023 at Rutgers University.
Sharyo is an LRV-cat. She was born/manufactured in Japan. She likes California rolls and candy.
Nowun is a feline-like demigod. He wears a cloak and wears an amulet and can shapeshift. He oversees the Alpha-Centauri planetary system.
Autumn is a fox. She likes mushrooms and listening to Sleep Token. She lives in a studio apartment with Sandy and Lawrence. She has a keyboard. She is transgender. She is a dry cleaner.
Nanika is a tuxedo cat with wings. She is extroverted. She is the leader of the notorious Joe's Bees.

secondary.description: Joey is a deer. They live in Arthur City. They like curly fries.
Flingy is a victini. She is Lit's sister. She was murdered on October 15, 2019, due to Lit's criminal activities, detailed in It's Been Awhile. Her favorite show was V and Ax.
Carc is a former student at Doubax Highschool and was a bully. He flushed Liam down the toilet. He likes the smell of Spanish's feathers. He dated Lily Flul, and is a friend of SCF.

Kyle is a socially ignorant popplio. He takes great pride in being an American. He lived in Texas on his family's cube corn farm until the house burned down. He has queer relatives living in northern Florida. He is friends with Umber.
Flaver is a fat, nervous Pikachu. She was friends with Flingy, and went on to develop an uneasy acquaintanceship with Lit after Flingy's death.
Turner is a rabbitoid who is a sociopath. He was the "leader" of the NDHS bully group, and went on to do horrible things. He is currently serving a life sentence in prison.

He is a male meowstic. He works for Friendship City Transit. He was formerly known as "Methlab" or, legally, "Baby Jutsja". His parents were neglectful meth addicts, but his uncle helped him to become a somewhat successful electrician.
Lily is a female meowstic who likes mathematics. She had romantic tension with Ball and Carc. She also may have been a love interest for Lit. She is a model.
Soiette is a silly Oshawott who likes to say "Dang, bitch!". He lives in Ebonwood, Evergreen. He plays Terraria.
Wayne is a cat. He lives in Highland Park. He likes to fish with Miki.
Pluto is a cream colored fox with touches of chocolate. Mmmmh... Deliciousch. She is Tem's friend-with-benefits, sister of Bowie, best friend of Noel, and... Mmmh... Deliciousch.
Bowie is a rollerskater fox. He is related to his sister Plubo. This is because they are siblings. It said so on the DNA test.
Kolumbus is a torracat, not a litten. He is a devout Christian. He is dating Bowie Butter. He reads Bowie scripture. Bowie does not appreciate this. They rollerskate together.
Ree is a Jirachi. Ree has no headpiece flops, unlike usual Jirachis. She is regularly featured in CoJu's comic series, "It's Been Awhile". Ree's family has been bankrupt since at least 2023.
She was a gardener Jirachi. He was Ree's sibling.
Emo Jirachi. Yup. He listened to all them emo bands. He was Ree's brother.
Henry Snyder is a leafeon. He is roommates with Umber.
Umber is a umbreon. He likes mystery novels and ran the NDHS book club. He had an alt right phase. He is Mar's brother. He never had sexual intercourse with Mar.

Mar is a grumpy espeon who suffers from job insecurity. He has a yellow smiley face on his belly and has always been bullied for it, so he wears a striped green shirt to hide it. This doesn't work out, since the face, who was his sibling he absorbed in the womb, eats the shirt. No. He doesn't usually eat the shirt. Mar also has another sibling, Umber. He wasn't absorbed inside of him. He never penetrated inside of him either.
Snodie is a vulpix. She is a witch and studied animal science at Verr University.
River is a cinderace who liked Japanese girls and his girlfriend, big Jodie. He was a stand-up comedian and jewlry store worker. He was killed in January 2020.
She is a transgender cyclops. Her boyfriend was River CoAlla.

Steel is a mischevious Sylveon. He is a scientist who looks after Ash. She is very impulsive, and has many tattoos that are covered by her fur. They are infertile, and treats Ash like the son he could never conceive.
Ray is a cat who has suicidal and self-destructive tendencies. He is friends with Steel and someone else. He likes the song Razor by Foo Fighterds.
Clarissa is a flareon who wears an elegant hat. This reflects her elegant, haughty personality. She is the counselor for North Doubax High School.
Glider, a gliscor, is the daughter of Ospra and Eastmode, the owners of Ospra's and K-Club respectively. She wears a Weezer cap, and will be a trucker shen she's older.
Lex is an intersex meowstic. She used to live in Boston, where her best friend Tem lived, before Tem moved away. A few years later, Lex moved to Arthur City. He works at K-Club.
Zilly is an alien from outer space. She works at Rocky's Records and Guitars.
Garland, commonly known as Sandy, is a mischevious and devious leafeon. She is confident and outgoing. Her brother is Lawrence.
Lawrence is a shy and nervious leafeon. This is in contrast to the clothes he wears. His sister is Garland. He likes to call her Gary and Garlic, but she doesn't like it.
Sprinkles is an Eevee.

Skyler is a Glaceon who is a horny bait streamer and a real estate agent. She often collaborates with Paige The Pennsylvanian. She is Sugar's older sister. She goes by @hotglaceon5 on at least one social media. She usually goes by SkylerWearsUnderwear.
Vick is an Umbreon. They are a mechanic. He lives with Avery.
Avery is a Leafeon. He lives with Victor.
Muppin is a cat.
Crys is half of a cat and half of an unknown type of bug. She is transginger.
Maureen is a cat.
Alice is Maureen's mother. She is... a cat. She is a notorious criminal in Radia, and she is often referred to as 'Alice The Shooter'.
Carlos is a midnight lycanroc.
Flam is a cat who worked as a captain for pirate ships from the Succaneer Isles. He died by gears grinding in April 1918.
Rivers was a pink dog from California, who then moved to Radia, CT. He was killed by Cypress in September 2020.
Jeremiah is an engineer who builds robots. He takes medication from a local herb store to take care of his mental illness.
Jimmy is an engineer who builds robots. He loves animals and nature.
Raby is a block creature. She used to be a human named Rosalind.
Rocket is not a block creature. She was rebuilt into Raby by Jimmy after being charred in a house fire. She didn't join the futurists until after the fire.

Pad was once a re-usable pad for Aslarvanillamor, a giant. Once Pad stopped being absorbant, the giant abandoned him in favor of Tampon. He has become enemies with Tampon. In 1659, he was killed in Mount Friday by mega Raby.
Jeck is a robot built by Jeremiah and Jimmy. He often gets destroyed in accidents.

Runchy, also called Reed and Aventi, is a little cat. He causes many problems due to his insecurities from being unable to skip stones. This is quite embarrasing, since he was born in Stoneskippersville, Dexterchussets.
Rohr is a victini. He is the mechanic and scientist of the group.
Tymmi is a shiny eevee. She had a sibling who died from an infection. They escaped from somewhere via sewer pipes. She is still in shock.
Ned is a person with a ear cleaner shaped head. He is the leader of The Pastors.
When Ned and Jerry wanted to have a child, they tried turning one of their sperm into a living being. This resulted in Juke Jon and another sperm derived organism who was seen chasing Moh.
Third triplet of Jeremiah and Jimmy. His husband is Ned Spuun. He studied finance and economics in university.

Ammie is a gorey creature who is constantly in pain. This is because he was brutally mauled by riot police at a peaceful protest. She likes Rush. In fact, she really likes him - she has a crush on him. Wait, no. I mean, She likes Rush. Rush is her favorite band. You know, the one from Canada. Whew, that was embarrasing!
Sepitina is a white short hair cat. She is a co-leader of SCF.
Kelp is a block creature with duck features. They are a co-leader of SCF. They were born in Mount Friday. They changed their name in September 2024.
Italian Guy is an italian guy.

He is a self proclaimed villain who has a major obsession with keys. He puts keys on omlettes and eats them and then chokes on them. He has a food truck van and a helicopter that's shaped like a key. His goal in life is to move to Southeast Pennsylvania.
Dave is a human creature with block features. He was born in Mount Friday. He is Maureen's father
Ninja is a block creature with human ninja features. He was born in Mount Friday.
Edibar Junior is a Ralts with forks for arms. He is Edibar's son. He made Erozon to cope with the absence of his father.
His left arm is a fork. His SCF outfit is a mushroom. He was taken by a rival group after a battle and was never seen since. SCF is trying to get him back. His wife is a Gardevoir.
Bee is a dragonite with hair. He is often working out and stuck in traffic. The width of his penis roughly is the same as Sepitina's head.
He is a deformed victini who was orphaned by his parents as a result... He died on January 13, 2025 due to complications.
Marze is a professor at Micheal Spring's Chocolate University. He is known for building robots, including Jeck. He is well known by Bee Kellap. Marze isn't actually part of SCF.
Daniel is a stupid tiger. His name is also stupid.

Rina is a white cat who has never been Danny's girlfriend ever since Danny became a Donut Snatcher. She runs the Sharia Lair, where she tries to harness the power of the demigods of the Solar System: Vinnie, Addie, and Sackie.
He is a rough white male.
Bin is a poo bunny who was formerly the pet of Terry. There is a replica of Bin made by the Futurists. He is friends with Liam and Martha.
Ezoron is a crosont monster who was once Edibar's pet.

info.name: Aster Kawiestmoda
info.occupation: Bassist for CAF and Employee for K-Club

secondary.description: Aster is a bat. He is Glider's older brother. He is trans. He is the bassist.

info.name: Eclipse Faecervine
info.occupation: Vocalist for CAF and Veterinarian Technician

secondary.description: Eclipse, a Jirachi, is the frontman of CAF. She is nonbinary.

info.name: Pegasus Nyukasa
info.occupation: Drummer for CAF and Garbage truck driver

secondary.description: Peggy is a lesbian vaporeon. She is the drummer.

info.name: Tigna Waterson Mose
info.occupation: Professor at Friendship University and Director of Mose's Lab

secondary.description: When he was a baby, he was a nasty naked cat. He made minions and his lab assistant was Comet. He may or may not have done experiments on Comet.
Gustavo is Mose's general assistant. His last name comes from DanTDM saying "go sand go" in Crazy Craft episode 11.
Far is a lab assistant.
Silver is a Lynn shaped umbreon with a Lynn shaped nose. WTF? Yes, you're right. His mother was a 14 year old umbreon who was raped by Piq-Al-Eni, one of Lynn's uncles.
Colette is a shiny creature. She works on Mose's army of cats and minions.
Gabriel is an FCPD police officer with no collarbone. He is a weeb. He is the de facto police commissioner for the FCPD.
Sheila is a plus sized woman.
Whitcaneyhopter is an FCPD police officer. His head is shaped like a tampon, and Gabriel makes fun of him for it.
He is the vocalist of Jiva Jinotice. He is bisexual.

info.name: Laiah Zaiope
info.occupation: Guitarist and Vocalist for Jiva Jinotice

secondary.description: She is an Australian trans woman who was born and raised in Atlantic City. She was a guitarist and vocalist for Jiva Jinotice. She moved to Seattle in 2005. She died in her apartment in December 2019. Her death is rumored to be caused by supernatural means.

info.name: Beui Antodaler
info.occupation: Keyboardist and Guitarist for Jiva Jinotice

secondary.description: She is a lesbian keyboardist and guitarist for Jiva Jinotice.
They are a bassist for Jiva Jinotice. They are nonbinary.
6 Year Old Fat Kid is a fat midget who is part of Jiva Jinotice. He is asexual. He is not actually 6 years old.
Snibbles is a wumo who is the drummer for Jiva Jinotice. They are asexual.
He is the father of Jeremiah, Jimmy, and Jerry. He has a degree in theoretical physics and the arts. This is why he married a clown.
Janet was the mother of Jeremiah, Jimmy, and Jerry. She was Jackson's wife until she died from an overdose after being divorced. She is short.
Willow is a vulpix.

Briar is a vulpix. She is a therapist. She is one of Oakwood's sisters.

[known as Tarr until a long time before Oct 7, 2025]
Vulpix. She is obsessed with the idea of being a twin, and calls herself Char to be more like Tarr, and she copies everything Tarr does. Tarr hates this.
Plainwood is Pinewood's mother. She has a history of alcohol abuse. She is often drunk and therefore kicked out of the home, and mostly just roams the area woods. She is effectively absent.
Threetails is Pinewood's father. He is lazy and often neglects Pinewood. He once asked Pinewood to get him a food truck burrito and if she didn't, he wouldn't feed her.
Anna is Martha and Murray's mother.
Ed is Martha's cousin (Duncan's son). Ed is deaf.
Duncan is Martha's uncle (Anna's brother).
Elena is Martha's little sister. She likes to come with Martha and Liam on recreational trips. Sometimes they'd go with Liam's little brother Leon. Elena may get in trouble.
Murray is Martha's brother.
Jo is a horned Vaporeon. He is a chill and nice guy. He reads books and plays on his Switch. He is Liam's brother.
Timothy, or The Big T, or T, is a Jolteon. He is Liam's brother-in-law.
Anthony (also known as Tony or Cool Flareon) is a very cool Flareon. He is often found at festivals and fairs, displaying himself as a Cool Flareon. He is Liam's cousin. He is big.
Liam and his siblings' mother.
Elle is Liam's leafeon cousin. She works at the Pulster Art Museum in Eirmandol. She is smug and has a superiority complex.
Liam's little brother.
Michelle is Liam's sister, who was been saved by Liam's hat in an unknown situation.
Noelle is Liam's sister. She has no bows or ribbons.
Rebecca is Liam's stepsister. She is insecure about her ribbon length.
Coco is a litten. She is dating Pearl, a sylveon who is Liam's stepsister.
He is a deer who is Diamond's ex-husband.
He is a vari who is Diamond's current husband.
He is a rabbit dog who is Diamond's ex-husband.
He is a leafeon who is Diamond's father.
She is a rabbit who is Diamond's mother.
Emerald is Diamond's sister.
He killed Lenz and a bunny. He was once the husband to Katie Cupcake. He is Lit and Flingy's biological father. He has a secret affair with Bel Cupcake.
Gus is Lit and Flingy's stepfather.
Gus is Lit and Flingy's mother.
Bel is Katie's sister. She has an affair with Seb.
Morgan is a male meowstic. He has a hidden illness which is expensive to treat. He is regularly away from home due to business trips.
Frankie is a female meowstic and a house painter. She is Ball's mother. Born Francesca Meeneymore. [name changed night of Oct 6, 2025. also given birthday]. Friends with Amber.
Penelope is a meowstic! She is Amber's sister, and is Amber's child's biological mother. She carries around a bag of truffles.
She is a 30 something year old lawyer. She is Arrow's sister.
He was once a punk rocker who got a lot of girls. He is Arrow and Ardenna's father.
She is Rocky's mother. Her name is not Kaitlic. She loves England.
He is Rocky's father. He runs a shop in the slums of Arthur City.
Dizzy is Nolan's mother. [Her name was changed in late October 2025]
Cant is a Democratic party politician from NY. His campaign slogan is: "I'm Juxis Cant, and I can't." He is Nolan's father.
Lydia is a cat who has to partially take care of her mentally ill father.
Lenore is a cat who fell down the stairs.
Akira is an LRV-cat. She and Sharyo are good friends.
Rush is an LRV-cat. In line with his name, he is very fast.
Spark is an LRV-cat. She and Rush are good friends.
Berger is an LRV-cat.
Trenton is a Jersey Arrow Cat. Or wolf. I don't know.
Iris is a cat.
Ivy is a cat. She is a guitarist.

Gardenia is a cat who is or was an undergraduate student at Princeton University. She dormed with June. June often uttered "Damn it, Cleaves!" due to how often she was bothered by Gardenia's shenanigans.
Venice is a creature. Friends with Merritt.
Merritt is a creature. Friends with Venice.
Tide is a blue cat. He is friends with Pea and Amulet.
Pea is an orange cat.

Ten Man is an entity who is known for creating the universe. He is often depicted in a humanoid form. It is known by at least one mortal on Earth that he was grounded by his mother and is stuck in his room for all eternity. He is made of Tennonite.
Beryl is a "giant sequoia that teleports on occasion". Of course, this is what the mortals on Earth described Beryl as.
Protector Weird is a Protector.
Cassot is a humanoid with an onion head. His energy was harvested by the life forms of Planet Coju.
Strobbot is a humanoid with a strawberry (or carrot) head. He caused a great flood on Planet Coju as punishment for them harvesting the energy of his best friend Cassot.
Bananot is a humanoid with a banana for a head.
Bananot is a humanoid with a banana for a head.
Mieoru is a vaporeon.

Lynn is a flat headed human. He is Chip's brother. This character is a self-insert of CoMo, representing his youthful self. In adulthood, Lynn is known as Moe, and his head is a sphere instead of a bowl.
Chip is a stubby individual with two or three personalities. This character is a self-insert of CoJu, representing its youthful self.
Chubby is a kid who loves cookies, beans, clouds, and Jupiter. He is Fishabit's brother in law. Also, his father was 16 when he was born.
Fishabit is a kid who loves the sea. She is Chubby's sister-in-law.
Jen is friends with Chip. She smokes.
Lenny is a punk who likes skateboarding. He probably listens to hip-hop or nu metal or something.

Terry is a buizel who is a neo-nazi and animal abuser. He masturbates to extreme hentai, furry porn, and photos of celestial objects which temperatures are above 5000 Celsius. He is a railfan and busfan. He has or had a pet poo bunny named Bin. His parents divorced and he lives with his uncle in Arthur City. Terry runs a bakery. More of his backstory is documented in CoJu's "Don't Call Me Terry" (2019), and the cancelled "953: Terry's Fascist Dictatorship" by CoMo and CoJu. He eats sticks of butter as a snack.
Bax is a creature who runs on software like Pam. He has a mildly successful [YouTube] channel. He lives in Barwick, Evergreen. Bax is best friends with Pam.
Pam is a protogen with rabbit features. She runs on Windows 11 and is therefore a bit slow. She lives in Barwick, Evergreen. Pam is best friends with Bax.
Carc does commissions for evil villains. This includes making bioweapons and monsters. Carc Jr. is his son. He is yet another negligent father.
Mr. Seet is a highschool dropout who has blond hair. He is acquanitences with Sepitina and Mr. Lock.
They are a giant menstruator. She used Pad for her Pad before Pad became a Bad Pad. Queen of Connecticut.
They are a giant with umbrellas for eyes and a mouth. King of Connecticut.

Petworth is a Republican politician from New Jersey. He is the current president of The United States. His vice president is Fredorak Meatham. He was the frontman of a mildly successful hair metal band in the 80s.
Meatham is a Republican politician from Utah. He is the current vice president of The United States.

Burna is a Democratic politician. She ran for Friendship City mayor in the 2020s. She formerly explored lands with Hannah Goria with Pecan Meowth and Pecan Espeon. She was friends with Merrice, who she met in grade school. It is unknown whether she got assassinated overseas.
GPR is the current mayor of Friendship City. He is part of the Democratic party.
Cryopia is a secret agent for the United States. He is Nolan's mentor. He has been friends with Windowson Mac since grade school.
Windowson Mac is a crypto bro who resides in the United States. He has been friends with Max Cryopia since grade school. He has right-leaning political and social views.

cojuverse.description: Rain is a tired Espeon journalist who lives with Paige. It teams up with Blair to reunite xem with xer siblings and put Lincoln in prison.
Blair is a shiny Espeon who is very extroverted and optimistic and generally energetic. Xe is a private investigator who suspects xer siblings are doing something they shouldn't be.
Reba is a hybrid between a Flareon and an Espeon. She is assertive. Reba stopped being shy on August 15, 2020.
Axel is a hybrid between a Flareon and an Umbreon! He hates doing anything. Unless it's for Reba. They also own a casino.
Crab is an Eevee who is friends with Nolan. Not actually cut out for the hitman thing.
MJ is a sad and homeless gun dealer who lives in Snowstorm.

Marianne is a sylveon. She's a tough, energetic leader. Marianne was a professional wrestler before getting involved in the criminal life. In fact, the destruction of her reputation was what made her turn to crime in the first place. Related to Sydney, but she doesn't know it.
Jam is a hybrid between an Espeon and a Flareon. Jam is very silly. It works at Aitana's, which is its adoptive older sister's pizza place.
October is a Glaceon. June's younger sister. She used to be born October 11, 2002.
OH MY GOD.... HERE SHE COMES... IT'S THE PENNSYLVANIAN! Paige is a Furret! She is sweet and a little quiet. Rain lives with him.
Sydney is a shiny Sylveon! He is a Russian bartender. Holds down a more stable bank telling job on the side. He is friends with Steel.
Adakite is a hybrid between a Meowstic and a Leafeon. Ne is a serious, grave demigod.
Vermillion is a hybrid between a Vulpix and a gorgon. She is a firey, loud demigod.
Saccharide is a Primarina-Azumarill hybrid. He is a manipulative, evil demigod.
Clementine is a flareon. She is a mystic scientist, and Jam and Marisol's unwilling adoptive mother.

info.name: Lexi Fairgrove
info.occupation: Mechanic, Roller Skating Instructor, and Indie Band Vocalist/Keyboardist

cojuverse.description: Lexi is a jolteon. She is an asexual lesbiano. She is very nice and cheerful!
Burnie is a flareon. He is big, fat, and pan. He is a chef. He is hyper. You'd think he drinks five cans of Red Bull every morning. Needlessly verbose.

June is a glaceon. She is a demisexual lesbian. She is a perfectionist - which makes her resent herself. Works well under pressure. Pretends to be stoic. June is studying business and medicine at the same time, because she's the prized family overachiever. She has a sister named October who her parents couldn't give half a damn about.
Lincoln is an espeon. He has some anger management issues. A charmer when he isn't screaming at you. He owns a museum, and may have killed his uncle for it.
Ion is A Skuntank! She is a drummer for OFFENSIVE CONTENT.
Ashley is an Absol! Vi is a guitarist for OFFENSIVE CONTENT
Mae is a 4'9 Fennekin. She is fun and bubbly and cheerful. Mae loves her garden, and plants in general. Apparently, she has a dog.
Amber is a Meowstic! They are dating Riley. Carves absurd things out of wood - one time, she made a whole mini-living room. One of Comet's mothers.
Riley is a Hattrem with Slurpuff elements? Apparently? What? Riley is deaf, and dating Amber. They're also fat, and tall. One of Comet's mothers. They are an alien.
Kory is a fallen demigod fox who lives in cyberdystopia.

Tessa is a cat from the future! She is is really interested in crime in the early 21st century. This is because she lives in the year 2092. I MEAN 2090. Also she's chubby. Tessa is friends with Rory, Apollo, and Carter (032023).

Val is a laid-back Snowstorm native who handles a lot of the Snowstorm Mares' affairs. Having hit it off with Brooklyn when she arrived back in 2016, they became close friends and built the city's Lavender Mares division from the ground up. When they aren't tending to the Snowstorm Mares, she likes to unwind with trap music and a pack of cigarettes.
Brooklyn is a pink glaceon who runs the Snowstorm Mares.
Matilda is Riley's strange cousin. She is crazy and 5'9. She changed her name on Nov 12, 2024.
Sapphire is serious and 5'7.
Tessa's friend.
Tessa's friend.
Tessa's friend.
Athena is a stern Wooloo who likes bees and archery.
Spice is a flareon who was too hot to die. They died anyway. They were well known for being a supporting character who was often in police chases.
London Kill is some dude. He needs meds for mild shitofrenia.
Kimberly is Lincoln's sister.
Cedar is a glaceon who looks dumb.
Johnny sucks, dude. Really really sucks. He is an insurance agent. He is 4 feet tall and weighs 13000 pounds.

Marisol seems happy enough running her late mother's business to an outsider, but really, she hates it more than you know. Keeping the restaurant alive ever since she was 11 with no one to help but her adopted sibling, Jam, has completely and utterly crushed her dreams of film school. But, well, it's fine! Not like she can work anywhere else without a diploma! That's just life, baby!
